item.subject: science
item.stem: Meena's grandmother has mixed some paddy grains with their light husks and wants to separate them by winnowing. In which situation will winnowing successfully separate the two parts of the mixture?

options.A: In a closed room where there is no moving air at all
options.B: On a windy day in an open courtyard, where the moving air carries the light husks farther away
options.C: On a still day, by simply leaving the mixture in a heap on the ground
options.D: In a closed container that is shaken gently without any air movement
